solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Vehicle reversing with weight of gems is a chancy enterprise

indicators.note: the vehicle is to be read backwards, as if driving in reverse

parts.note: a cab is a vehicle, a taxi
a carat is the unit of weight for precious stones

explanation.surface: A jeweller's van backing up with a load of precious stones sounds like a risky business.
explanation.definitionFit: Baccarat is a casino card game, so playing it is a gamble decided largely by luck.

clue.text: Hate a man becoming this?

indicators.note: the words hate a man turn into something else, their letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A wry question: if you hate a man, what does he become to you?
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does double duty: the letters of HATE A MAN rearrange into the answer, and a hated man becomes exactly that.
explanation.definitionFit: Anathema is something or someone intensely loathed, so a hated man becomes one.

clue.text: No restrictions here as church is set in converted tabernacle

indicators.note: the church abbreviation is placed inside the other letters
the tabernacle is converted, so its letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A religious building is being converted, and a church is set up inside it with nothing holding the builders back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converted' makes CARTEBLANE from TABERNACLE, and 'is set in' puts CH among those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Carte blanche is complete freedom to act as one wishes, with no limits imposed.

clue.text: Bar shut by priest in Catholic Venice once, say

indicators.note: the priest-and-bar combination sits inside the Catholic abbreviation

parts.note: RC stands for Roman Catholic

indicators.note: the bar is enclosed by the priest's name on either side

parts.note: Eli is the priest in the Book of Samuel, a crossword regular
a pub is a bar

explanation.surface: A Catholic priest closes the bar in historic Venice.
explanation.walkthrough: ELI is the biblical priest who raised Samuel. 'once, say' marks Venice as an example of a former state.
explanation.definitionFit: Venice was for centuries an independent state governed without a monarch, the Most Serene Republic.

clue.text: Defame jazz function in speech

indicators.note: the words are spoken, so what counts is how they sound

parts.note: trad is traditional jazz and use means function, together trad use

explanation.surface: Something about the role jazz plays in a speech.
explanation.definitionFit: To traduce someone is to slander them, damaging their good name with falsehoods.

clue.text: Coarse fabric no use with felt in the middle

parts.note: duff is slang for useless or worthless

indicators.note: only the central letters of felt are taken

explanation.surface: A rough cloth that is useless unless it has felt at its core.
explanation.definitionFit: Duffel is a thick woollen cloth with a heavy nap, used for coats and bags.

clue.text: Hand on tradition, ultimately giving pledge

indicators.note: in a down clue the hand sits on top of the next piece

parts.note: a paw is a hand, informally

indicators.note: only the final letter of tradition is used

explanation.surface: Passing on a tradition ends in making a solemn promise.
explanation.definitionFit: To pawn something is to deposit it as security for a loan, i.e. to pledge it.

clue.text: So-called priest has to tear round all the time

indicators.note: the word for tear goes round the phrase for always

parts.note: to rend is to tear
ever means always, all the time

explanation.surface: A priest in name only who must forever rush about.
explanation.definitionFit: Reverend is the title by which a clergyman is styled, so a priest is called this.

clue.text: Coarse stuff witch squeezed into powder

indicators.note: the witch is pressed inside the word for powder

parts.note: rouge is a red cosmetic powder
a hag is an ugly old witch

explanation.surface: Something rough, like a witch crammed into a powder compact.
explanation.definitionFit: Roughage is coarse fibrous plant matter in the diet that aids digestion.

clue.text: Not that good a place of entertainment

definitions.meaning: a funfair with rides and stalls

explanation.surface: A grudging review of a venue: not all that good.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair means moderate or average in quality, and a fair is also a travelling show with rides.

clue.text: Fond creature struggling in race

indicators.note: the creature is struggling, so the letters of fond creature are thrown about

explanation.surface: A beloved animal labouring in a contest.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tour de France is the famous annual multi-stage cycling race around France.

clue.text: Hymn sensational cricketer

parts.note: amazing means sensational
W. G. Grace, the great Victorian English cricketer

explanation.surface: Praise for a hymn and for a sensational cricketer.
explanation.walkthrough: W. G. Grace was the most famous English cricketer of the nineteenth century.
explanation.definitionFit: Amazing Grace is a well-known Christian hymn written by John Newton.

clue.text: Ad-lib regularly about keeping pet

indicators.note: the held letters are turned round, read backwards
the words ad-lib regularly hold the letters within them

explanation.surface: Improvising now and then about looking after a pet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' looks like an alternate-letter signal, but it simply supplies letters for the hidden run.
explanation.definitionFit: A gerbil is a small burrowing rodent commonly kept as a household pet.

clue.text: Close up part of church on Hebridean island

indicators.note: the church part is placed after the island

parts.note: Coll is an island in the Inner Hebrides off western Scotland
the apse is the semicircular recess at the east end of a church

explanation.surface: Closing up the apse of a church on a Scottish island.
explanation.walkthrough: COLL is a small island of the Inner Hebrides, off Scotland's west coast.
explanation.definitionFit: To collapse something like a table or umbrella is to fold it in on itself.

clue.text: Stationary traffic at main road around island

parts.note: a jam is a queue of stopped traffic
the A1 is Britain's longest numbered road, written AI in crosswords
ca is short for circa, meaning around

explanation.surface: Gridlock on a main road round an island.
explanation.walkthrough: The A1 is the main road from London to Edinburgh; the figure 1 is read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Jamaica is a large island nation in the Caribbean Sea.

clue.text: Started from chair, appearing arrogant

definitions.meaning: leapt suddenly out of one's seat
self-important, having risen above one's station

explanation.surface: Someone who leapt out of their seat, looking full of themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Jumped up describes a sudden leap upward, and as an adjective a conceited upstart.

clue.text: Short rope network, a way to catch one

indicators.note: the network and way together hold the numeral inside

parts.note: LAN is a local area network
RD is short for road, a way
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A short line, a net and a path used to snare someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A laniard, or lanyard, is a short cord used on ships or to hang a whistle or pass.

clue.text: Presumably favouring genuine short hymn

indicators.note: the phrase is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: someone against what is phoney would be anti-phony, so in favour of the genuine

explanation.surface: A short hymn apparently backing authenticity.
explanation.walkthrough: The jokey coinage ANTI-PHONY, against fakery, is what one 'favouring genuine' would be; 'Presumably' admits it is invented. 'short' drops the final Y.
explanation.definitionFit: An antiphon is a short chant or anthem sung in alternating parts during worship.

clue.text: Don't agree, being around at home, to make another brew?

indicators.note: the refusal wraps itself around the word for at home

parts.note: to refuse is to decline, not agree
in means at home

explanation.surface: Declining to agree while at home, then putting the kettle on again.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinfuse is to steep leaves again, as when brewing a second pot of tea.

clue.text: Take ages, having small fits

parts.note: to be long is to take a long time
S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: Someone takes forever over small fits of temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fits' looks like a noun, outbursts; it is the verb, as in 'it fits here'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that belongs is in its right place, so it fits there.

clue.text: The London Eye?

parts.note: in Cockney rhyming slang an eye is a ..., so a Londoner's eye

explanation.surface: A question about the giant observation wheel on the Thames.
explanation.walkthrough: The London Eye is the big wheel on the South Bank, but here the clue means a Londoner's eye: in Cockney rhyming slang, eyes are 'mince pies'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cockney rhyming slang swaps eye for a word rhyming with it, a festive pastry.

clue.text: Language of particular concern heard

indicators.note: the clue's word is spoken, so its sound is what matters

parts.note: pigeon as in 'not my pigeon', one's own business or concern

explanation.surface: A language one is especially worried about being overheard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That's not my pigeon' is a British idiom meaning that's not my responsibility.
explanation.definitionFit: A pidgin is a simplified mixed language used between groups without a common tongue.

clue.text: Losing energy, predator is in waterway

indicators.note: the predator drops a letter

parts.note: a tiger is a big predator
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A predator in a river is running out of steam.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tigris is a major river of Mesopotamia, flowing through Turkey and Iraq.

clue.text: One trying to hear what deciduous tree is misses the start

indicators.note: the description loses its first letter

parts.note: a deciduous tree sheds its foliage, so it is a leaves-dropper

explanation.surface: A listener trying to work out what a deciduous tree is, but missing the start.
explanation.walkthrough: A deciduous tree, as a punning description, is a LEAVES DROPPER; 'misses the start' removes its L.
explanation.definitionFit: An eavesdropper secretly listens in on others' private conversations.

clue.text: Manage to avoid missing a green

indicators.note: the phrase for avoid goes without the letter a

parts.note: to avert is to ward off or prevent

explanation.surface: A golfer trying to avoid missing the green.
explanation.walkthrough: Vert is the heraldic name for green.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry the tincture green is called by its Old French name.

clue.text: Finish off a sort of bike in pale blue

indicators.note: the bike loses its final letter

parts.note: a quad bike is a four-wheeled motorbike

explanation.surface: Completing a bike painted in light blue.
explanation.definitionFit: Aqua is a light greenish-blue colour, like clear seawater.

clue.text: Keeping son away from jail, taking advantage of revolution

indicators.note: the word for exploiting holds the shortened jail inside it

parts.note: using means exploiting, taking advantage of

indicators.note: the son is taken out of the jail

parts.note: a prison is a jail

explanation.surface: Someone keeps their son out of jail by exploiting a revolution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away from' removes SON from PRISON, leaving PRI.
explanation.definitionFit: An uprising is a popular revolt against authority, a revolution.

clue.text: Endures travelling, and departs for Split

indicators.note: the letters of endures move about

parts.note: D is the timetable abbreviation for departs

explanation.surface: A traveller puts up with the journey and leaves for Split, the Croatian port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Split' looks like the Croatian city, a destination; it is the verb, broken apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Sundered means split apart or severed, torn into separate pieces.
